SRC-394:R001.text: Do not ask the operator to approve the current capsule until the two defects below are repaired and independently verified.

SRC-394:R002.text: Do not create a new orchestration framework, weaken native operator provenance or bypass the authority broker.

SRC-394:R003.text: A goal-management command is NEVER a goal-entry objective.

SRC-394:R012.text: Do not merely classify inspection as "continue" if that path has side effects.

SRC-394:R013.text: DO NOT TREAT THIS AS VERIFIED MAINTENANCE-GOAL AUTHORITY.

SRC-394:R014.text: If the canonical maintenance model must remain separate from goal continuation, implement the narrow supported authority bridge instead of quietly substituting the old test pivot.

SRC-394:R015.text: Do not rewrite historical pivot events or journal receipts.

SRC-394:R016.text: Do not use an old goal as the authority anchor for a different persistent goal without an explicit authenticated and verifiable delegation contract.

SRC-394:R017.text: An approval preview must show the actual maintenance objective, allowed operations, exact project, scope, budget, expiry policy, revocation path, and excluded actions.

SRC-394:R018.text: Wrong goal, stale source, altered objective, mismatched provider or mismatched project must fail closed.

SRC-394:R019.text: The approval event must originate in a real trusted human interaction.

SRC-394:R020.text: Do not treat an agent's shell or text as consent.

SRC-394:R021.text: The native broker must verify exact proposal identity and revocation/budget scope at commit time.

SRC-394:R022.text: Do not mark unattended autonomy production-ready merely because the operator approval process is repaired.

SRC-394:R023.text: Do not fabricate TURN_STARTED, TURN_COMPLETED or broker proof.

SRC-394:R024.text: User typing "saipen goal propose" never creates a goal.

SRC-394:R025.text: User typing "saipen goal status/list/eval" never creates a goal.

SRC-394:R026.text: Goal pause/resume/add/replenish cannot become pivot objectives.

SRC-394:R027.text: Explicit intended goal-entry syntax still works.

SRC-394:R028.text: Authorized goal grant syntax remains distinct.

SRC-394:R029.text: CLI and native hook resolve the same command semantics.

SRC-394:R030.text: Read-only preview creates zero project mutations.

SRC-394:R032.text: Operator approval for a different goal is refused.

SRC-394:R033.text: Historic test pivot cannot silently authorize self-maintenance.

SRC-394:R034.text: A valid current maintenance grant is accepted once.

SRC-394:R035.text: Expiry, revocation, duplicate approval and wrong scope fail.

SRC-394:R036.text: Protocol-home checkpoint does not grant arbitrary mutations.

SRC-394:R037.text: Release approval remains a separate authority.

SRC-394:R038.text: Genuine installed-host continuation remains a separate gate.

SRC-394:R040.text: Shared Git index and foreign owners remain protected.

SRC-394:R041.text: Do not prompt the operator to authorize the old "test1" capsule.

SRC-394:R042.text: SRC-394's core demand: repair and independently verify the two goal-authority defects (a goal-management command sealed as a goal-entry objective, and grant authority anchored to a historic test pivot) BEFORE asking the operator to approve any capsule; wrong goal, stale source, altered objective, mismatched provider/project, model-authored capsule and historic test pivot must fail closed; the read-only preview must create zero mutations and must never present a refusal as available authority.
